records.name: IITs
records.description: Premier autonomous public technical universities established by the Government of India, renowned for undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in engineering, technology, and sciences. Admission is through JEE Advanced.

records.name: NITs
records.description: National Institutes of Technology are centrally funded technical institutes spread across India, offering top-tier engineering and technology programs. Admission is through JEE Main.

records.name: VIT
records.description: Vellore Institute of Technology is a private deemed university known for its wide range of engineering and technology programs, strong industry connections, and research output.

records.name: IIITs
records.description: Indian Institutes of Information Technology are publicly funded institutes focused exclusively on information technology, computing, and related disciplines. Admission is through JEE Main.

records.name: IITs (Data Science programs)
records.description: Select IIT campuses offering specialized undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Data Science, AI, and Statistics, combining mathematical rigor with computational training.

records.name: ISI Kolkata
records.description: Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata is a premier autonomous institution of national importance dedicated to statistics, mathematics, computer science, and quantitative economics.

records.name: CMI Chennai
records.description: Chennai Mathematical Institute is a highly selective research and teaching institute focused on mathematics, theoretical computer science, and physics, known for its strong academic culture.

records.name: IISc Bangalore
records.description: Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore is India's foremost research university, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across sciences, engineering, and design.

records.name: IIT Kanpur (Cyber Security)
records.description: IIT Kanpur offers a specialized postgraduate program in Cyber Security, leveraging one of India's strongest computer science and engineering departments.

records.name: CDAC
records.description: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing is a government-funded autonomous institute offering postgraduate diploma programs in advanced computing, software development, and IT.
